name: Home Screen Sections (Fork)
overview: Fork build for testing (includes Danish localization).
description:
Adds support for server provided home screen sections.

This is a personal fork build used for testing translations and changes. Install File Transformation and Plugin Pages as well.

Preview 2.5.19.0 — TypeScript + upstream triage batch (prerelease)



Test build from feat/typescript-sdk-types. Covers changes since 2.5.18.0:



- Upstream triage batch 1 (8 fixes, #25): skip virtual folders without ItemId (#182), admin-only RegisterSection + refuse overwrites (#258), empty SectionSettings -> empty page not 500/hang (#247), normalize multi-instance limits (#153), stop scroll-listener leak + dead title chevrons + unfocusable cards (#242/#196/#233), warn in config when File Transformation/Plugin Pages missing (#234), plus analyzer/null-limit/async-hang follow-ups.

- CI/Quality (#23, #26, #24): unit test suite + 80% coverage gate, CSharpier formatting with PR auto-fix, CLAUDE.md dev docs.

- New — Strict TS 7 web assets: src-web/ now typed against @jellyfin/sdk 0.13 (BaseItemDto etc.), tsc -> src/.../*.js via BeforeBuild hook, {{layoutmanager_hook}} placeholders restored by scripts/replace-placeholders.mjs. Source is TS-only (JS gitignored); ci.yml/build-release.yml now run setup-node@4 + npm ci + typecheck.



Test focus: home rows/forms, infinite scroll not leaking, title links, TV focus, empty-settings, config dependency warnings.



Install: prerelease zips Release-10.10.7.zip / 10.11.5 / 10.11.11 from this tag.

## What's new in 2.5.18.0



Adds **ten new home screen sections** so the home can show more of what you already have in Jellyfin.



### New sections



| Section | Title | What it shows |

|---------|--------|----------------|

| Favorites | Favorites | Items you've hearted |

| RandomUnwatched | Surprise Me | Random unwatched movies/series |

| Trending | Most Played | Your highest play-count titles |

| RecentlyPlayed | Recently Played | Finished watches (not in-progress) |

| Kids | Kids & Family | G / PG / TV-Y–PG rated titles |

| ComingSoonInLibrary | Coming Soon | Library items with a future premiere date |

| Decade | e.g. 2010s Movies | Multi-instance rows by decade |

| Studio | Studio name | Multi-instance from watch history |

| Playlists | Playlist name | One row per non-empty playlist (skips "My List") |

| UnwatchedCollections | Continue: {collection} | Unwatched items from partially watched box sets |



### Other

- English + Danish strings for the new section titles

- README lists the extra sections



### Merged

- #22 Add 10 extra home screen sections



### Install

Add this repository in Jellyfin:



https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Robert-Hansen/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections/main/manifest.json



Then install **Home Screen Sections** and pick the zip for your Jellyfin version (10.10.7 / 10.11.5 / 10.11.11).



Enable the new rows under **admin Section Settings** and/or **user Modular Home**.

## What's new in 2.5.17.0



Fork polish release: configuration UX, home behaviour, diagnostics, and docs. Builds on **2.5.16.0**.



### Admin — Section Settings

- Live **home order preview** ("Home will look like…") as you reorder sections

- **Import conflict handling**: summary of matched, unknown (skipped), and missing (unchanged) section IDs

- Confirm dialog, drag/arrows/keyboard reorder, search, bulk enable/disable, undo, and export/import (from recent releases) remain



### Admin — Global Settings

- **Section Diagnostics** panel (`GET HomeScreen/Diagnostics`): plugin enabled, section counts, Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Readarr/Jellyseerr and library hints (no library content scan)



### User — Modular Home

- **Drag-and-drop** personal section order (plus arrows)

- **Reset to server defaults** (still requires Save)

- **Save toast** instead of a full page reload



### Home screen

- **Hardened clickable titles**: validate routes so dead chevrons are avoided

- More title routes (Live TV, My List, Continue Watching, Next Up combo, collections/playlists/genres)

- **Clear in-memory section cache** when admin config is saved or cache is busted so the home screen updates immediately



### Accessibility and localization

- Dialog focus trap, labelled confirm dialog, live dirty-status region

- Danish (`da`) strings for all new UI; EN/DA key parity checked in CI



### Docs

- README **What's new in this fork** section comparing this fork to the original IAmParadox27 plugin

- Catalogue install URL for this fork's `manifest.json`



### Merged since 2.5.16.0

- #9 Harden section title links

- #10 Clear in-memory home section cache on save

- #11 User Modular Home drag-and-drop reorder

- #16 More clickable section titles (routes)

- #17 Accessibility pass for section settings dialog

- #19 Integrate remaining polish (reset, preview, toast, import conflicts, diagnostics)

- #20 README fork features vs original



### Install

Add this repository in Jellyf
